Treating Phase 9C iteration backlog as a backend issue tracker or formal production roadmap

Do not mutate UserAppTemplatePackage from Phase 9C iteration plan, backlog, priority framework, sessions, preferences, recommendations, content QA, feedback, or admin panels.
Do not write real internal trial participant records into project-state or training datasets.

Do not train directly from SourceImagePackage or user photo/profile/preference/recommendation/session/readiness/browser QA/release readiness/go-no-go/operations/observation/outcome/review/iteration data.
Do not expand legacy frozen modules.
